feat(mercury): automate protected value lifecycle (#54)

Mercury now loads Protected Value keyrings only at startup and the worker automatically reconciles bootstrap, stable cohort coverage, activation, rewrap enqueue, and startup-only paused rotation resume.

The four Protected Value administrative CLI entrypoints and SIGHUP reload wiring are removed. Underlying cryptography, readiness, integrity, backup, and rewrap capabilities remain.

Independent review found and verified fixes for generation monotonicity and pre-staged anti-rollback handling.
